suggested_change: Rubric should distinguish between: (A) legitimate score regression with documented call evidence vs. (B) unexplained regression; (C) establish clear carry-forward rules—either scores must persist unless contradicted by new data, or analysis may reset with explicit justification. CRITERION 4 should accept 'by next call' if call cadence is documented, or define required specificity thresholds upfront. CRITERION 5 should not contradict explicit cumulative state without citing specific new call content.
